title: Database connection pool exhaustion
symptoms: Error rate jumped to 60%. Logs flooding with: psycopg2.OperationalError: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections. P99 latency > 10s. All API endpoints returning 503.
root_cause: Sudden traffic spike caused all 20 DB connections to be held open simultaneously. A slow unindexed JOIN query on the orders-users table was holding connections for 8-12 seconds each, preventing release. No connection pooler was in place.
fix_applied: 1. Restarted application servers to release held connections. 2. Deployed PgBouncer connection pooler in transaction mode. 3. Added composite index on orders(user_id, created_at). 4. Set statement_timeout=5s in PostgreSQL config.
